steps.name: Delivery's Adventurer (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」, obtain <Scylla's Doll Hat>, <Ficus' Sewing Failure>, and <Horn of Glaucus> from 「Mirror of the Abyss」 and 「Eugamon Theater」 and bring them to [Arche].

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s Seeing that you have come, it looks like the spirit that flew away from Pneuma has found its way to you.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Was it okay for you to come this time? As I said before, my whole body hurts like it's going to break, or the heat feels like it's going to disappear... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank goodness. Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I heard that after visiting Pneuma, you went to Aie Island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It came from my meeting with Hayden.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: As Adventurer saved Hayden, the spirits here were able to reach Aie Island.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Oh, that's right. Arche, what did you call me for?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: In my heart, I want to go to Aie Island and help Hayden... . I can't leave this place, so I'd like to ask Adventurer a favor.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Due to the witch's curse, the spirits on Aie Island left or disappeared. So, the magic flowing through Aie Island may have been slightly contaminated.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The spirits of Pneuma are going to come and do the cleansing, but there's work to be done before that.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: We need to figure out the meaning of the curse that was shaking Aie Island. If you go here recklessly, the precious spirits may disappear without being able to do their work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what can I do to help you?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Could you please bring me something belonging to the owner of Aie Island? If that were the case, I think the spirits would be able to work hard.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If you have their items, you can give them to them right away, but if you don't have them, I would like you to get them and bring them to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, Arche. I'll bring it to you right away.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you. You know this feeling is not a secret, right? Hehehe.

steps.name: Delivery's Adventurer (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」, and find the person that Lepton responds to in 「Nereis Gate」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's more than you think, right? Thank you for your hard work in rescuing me.
(As Arche receives the item from %s, spirits recognize him from afar and approach him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do the spirits recognize the items I got?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes, that's right. If the spirits that convey emotions feel the emotions from this object, that's it.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I think the owner of this item is a strong person. The will and heart to not lose oneself until the end even if one is cursed... .
(With Arche's words, the items brought from Aie Island float in the air. Then, they slowly turn into sand in an hourglass and scatter somewhere in Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now the spirits will go to Aie Island and begin purification with Hayden.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Although we can't bring back the bodies of those who have become dolls, we can still bring the island back to that time a little while ago.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: A long time ago… .
(Arke continues speaking and then looks surprised.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's nothing. Suddenly, I remembered the old days of Aie Island. I don't know why it came to mind.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Could you please do me one more favor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me, Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I have an Elec Repton that needs to go to Nereis Gate, not Aye Island. Can you take me there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not difficult, but can we just go together? Ah, it stings. This lepton. Why are you going to the gateway?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I think there is someone who needs the help of a spirit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, come on! all right. Then all I have to do is go to the person who reacts to Lepton? Oh, come on!

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If it still stings, can I give you a blanket or something? It's made from the fur that Kairos exudes, so it'll be fine as long as you keep it wrapped around you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really? Then, I will go straight to the Nereis Gate.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you. I think the spirits really like %s. Even when a spirit is born... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, what does it mean for a spirit to be born?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Ah… , it’s a secret.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's a real secret.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You may find out someday, and I may tell you, but for now, it's a secret. sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Because it's not important now.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you for your cooperation in maintaining confidentiality. Please be careful where you go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then Arche is well.
(Upon arriving at the Nereis Gate, Lepton in %s's arms blinks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Uh, Lepton. what's the matter?
(Lepton flies up and watches where Edam is.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was Edam the person Lepton was trying to help?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's gone... . I guess Edam is right. Should I ask Edam what's going on?

steps.name: Delivery's Adventurer (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Edam] at “Nereis Gate” and visit [Talos] in “Knossos.”

lines.text: (In a quiet time when people using the Nereis Gate have left, Edam is looking blankly at the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Edam? What are you thinking?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Yes? Ah, %s. Are you here?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Think for a moment… . no. After that incident, I feel like this sometimes. Sometimes I feel dazed and anxious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: There is no problem in real life, but it is difficult to work as an escort or security guard... .

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I have to overcome it somehow and be helpful to Notos, Bjor, and %s... . I'm just embarrassed to be in this state.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I can see how pitifully my younger brother would look at me like this. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Sorry. I didn't mean to say this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Thank you for your consideration even though you are busy. We've just organized %s's listing.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: If you visit the Nereis Gate, feel free to go up to the second floor of the building where Notos and I work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which room is it?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Just enter [the room of the great %s].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Hey, do you want to change the name of your room?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Since His Majesty gave us the name of the room, it seems difficult to change it easily. But, there is a way… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, there is a way. What method?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: All you have to do is go to the audience with His Majesty and tell him that you want to change your name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll just take it easy. It looks incredibly comfortable. Anyway, thank you for your concern, Edam.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: No. I just did what I had to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha… . Come to think of it, it was in Edam and Knossos, right?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Yes, Knossos was my last station as a guerrilla. It was a quiet and desolate place.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: After coming here and seeing a lot of people, it seems like there are a few more symptoms.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There wasn't much of a daze in Knossos?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I received a massage from a prisoner named Talos, and it seemed to be effective. He said his hands were a healing potion and asked me to pick up trash.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos likes picking up trash? You mean Talos?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Do you know Talos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something happened in Knossos. Should I say he’s an interesting person… . Why are you so surprised?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Although they are usually called beastmen, I was surprised to see that they were never called human. sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Edam is not sorry. So what do you call them?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: They are often referred to simply as ‘sujin’. I too have perceived it that way since I was young... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Talos only has animal ears like the Kali people, but they are not treated as humans...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now that I’m thinking about going to Knossos….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Edam, I think we should go to Knossos. I remembered something I had forgotten... .

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I've been holding onto Adventurer for a long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Edam. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: (Somehow, since %s came, I feel like the dazed feeling has diminished... What is it...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something is shocking... . If the people of Freios treat someone with animal ears that way... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it stings… .  Lepton?
(In front of %s, Elec Repton, who hovered around Edam and then disappeared, appears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When you're done, go back to Pneuma. I have a place to go... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What are you writing in the air? nice. paddle. cow. S. Same. this. go?
(With those words, Repton approaches %s's side and sticks to him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … okay. okay. Let's go. But it seems heavier than before?
(Lepton appears to have understood what he said and moves his gaze to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait… . I said it was heavy for no reason, so don't worry about it!! How heavy must a spirit be... . Ahhh, it stings!!

steps.name: Adventurer of delivery (4)
steps.objective: First, talk to [Talos] in “Knossos.” Next, defeat [Glaucus] at the “Eugamon Theater” to obtain “Glaucus’ Weapon”, then return to “Knossos” and talk to [Talos] again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Talos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Are you here today because you want to find out something from me? It doesn't end with picking up trash... .
(Talos is surprised to recognize the leptons hovering around %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It's a fresh spirit from Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you recognize it? no… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not a fish that a spirit sells on a market stall.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'm just telling the truth, what's the problem?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. That's not it... .
(Lepton climbs up to Talos and begins to look around Knossos.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Why did you bring that spirit here? The spirit will go about its business on its own... . When I see you being led by my hand... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: If you look at the face that looks like a distorted Freeling, you really don't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It originally had a different destination, but since then it's just been following me. Other than that, I don't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, what is that freeling-like expression?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Well, that's enough. The will of some great being that neither you nor I know may have been revealed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lepton, what do you want to do?
(The flying lepton looks at the sky of Knossos and points somewhere with what appears to be its wings. After a while, it flies deep inside Knossos at high speed.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: That spirit went to the Beast King. I guess I need someone's help if I'm going to be trapped.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Well, I won't just go back anyway. While it lasts, it will be of help to the lives of Knossos. I don't know anything else, but I'm thankful to the spirits.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Okay, if you're done, go back now. I'm going to go to sleep... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I'd like to ask.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You can't wear it bare-faced.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: On the way up to Knossos, I pulled out some weeds and took out the trash.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: That's not enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wonder if it's something like the magic broom from the magic academy... .
(Talos' pupils widen at the mention of a magic broom.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What? Magic broom? Could it be that the broom is alive, moves, and cleans automatically?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I had a hard time because of that... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: No, you're writing something that good? Damn, I'm jealous... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Talos is really serious about cleaning.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll talk to Magic Academy Zerenes later. Can you possibly get one?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Thank you, but that's not enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehe, I've shown such sincerity, but haven't I gone too far?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I can't help it. Because it's not in my hands right now. Now that I think about it, it looks like you met someone related to God.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I guess I didn't have the courage to come forward myself, so I created something like an incarnation... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You didn't say a word about the Incarnation, so how does Talos know?)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Don't think about useless things, but go to the incarnation and ask for something that Daedalus would like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Daedalus….)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Hehe, I know what you’re thinking. So don't do anything stupid. Just say he's alive.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What are you doing? Aren't you going? Please be careful, should I at least say something like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it. That aside, if I don't come, you won't be able to see the magic broom or anything.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Let's do the cleaning together with the idiot guerrillas over there. Even though it's for the God you believe in, you still won't do it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm going. song.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You still have a long way to go. If you want to beat me with words... . what?  Did you go? Why are you going? The story isn't over yet.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I guess I won because I made it more annoying... ?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Oh, it's you. Nice to meet you.
(As soon as he enters the theater, Glaucus greets %s by raising his hand and one of his many legs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. Glaucus? The greeting is very harsh.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I think I surprised you by saying hello to you because you were so happy to see me. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, I'm fine. But what were you doing?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I was doing maintenance on the theater. Apparently, there was a lot of commotion and there were broken places here and there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will help too. Because I was the reason the theater was destroyed.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Nope. Hayden and Scylla are helping, and there are spirits, so it's okay.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I can't entrust a difficult task to the benefactor who saved the island and everyone else.
(Glaucus smiles and raises the foot holding the hammer.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Oops… . I guess I got used to this look without even realizing it. You act so naturally while repairing the stage... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: As I was repairing it, I kept thinking that it would be nice for people to come here and see my play.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It will definitely happen that way.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Thank you. Once the stage is properly prepared, I will invite you under the authority of the leader.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you just for your words.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: By the way, seeing as you're here, it seems like I have some business to attend to... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Don't worry, just talk. Would you give me a chance to repay my benefactor for giving me the chance to live again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let me tell you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Glaucus what Talos said.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Daedalus... ?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: It's been a long time since I heard that name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know him?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I know. He was a good and kind man who followed God.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You weren't the same personality before...? Why are you like that now?)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: It's something Daedalus would like... . Oh, there is... . It'll be okay.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: So… . Hey, do you have a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. But what's going on?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: The item I'm giving him is the weapon I'm holding.  I'm trying to give you something different from what I always write.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I still want to test it to see if it's useful, and I'd like your help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means… .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Just like you worked with me last time, I hope you can help me practice this time too. It may be a sparring match for you, but... . Don't worry too much. You can think of it as having some light fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sparring with Glaucus... , it won't be easy.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: The story about Daedalus will be told after the sparring.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: While I'm looking for it in the theater warehouse, I'd like you to come to the final stage. The warehouse is behind the stage.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Do you remember the stage with a view of the sea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I remember. I'll go there.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Thank you. See you later then.
(Glaucus quickly goes backstage and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there something special about that weapon? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, let's spar with Glaucus and listen to his story.
(As the sparring progresses, a satisfied smile spreads on Glaucus' face.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I think this is enough. Now put away your weapons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I was wondering how long I should do this.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Now, take this.
(Glaucus hands the weapon he was holding to %s.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: It was originally made as a prop for a play, but it turned out better than I expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a pretty sharp and hard weapon.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Right? I made it inspired by what a traveler who once visited this island was holding.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When is that?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Because it was before the Continent of Freios was divided... . Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like an incredibly long time ago. Oh, you said you would speak after the sparring, right?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Then I will tell you. About your relationship with Daedalus... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I was born as an incarnation of God, but as I received the gift of life, I was able to understand it little by little. That I am a lacking being who has more things I cannot do than things I can do.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I tried to do many things to make up for that lack. Because I believed that this experience would be helpful to other lives.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: We hoped that many visitors would come and enjoy everything this island has to offer. It didn't go well, but it wasn't that bad.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: You just have to move forward based on your mistakes... . Because that's what life is like. But that's okay... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: It was always difficult to watch the life around you die. Because all I had to do was take care of him... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I no longer remember how many spirits and animals disappeared from my side.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: When Scylla was stranded on Aie Island, unconscious, it seemed like it was going to happen any minute. However, at some point, Scylla developed a fever and was unable to wake up.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I wanted to save the dying Scylla based on my experience accumulated over a long period of time, but there was nothing I could do. Because life has become helpless in the face of death.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The incarnation of God was looking at life with such emotions...)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Meanwhile, a brother came to this island that was hidden and unseen among the magical vortex.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Talos and Daedalus. The two arrived here after passing through a vortex of magical power. To get my advice… .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I remember him as a person who worked hard to coexist with the Kingdom of Sylvaria, which was trying to seize hegemony on the continent, and Creed, the territory of the beastmen... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (According to Mediah, the current Talos is Daedalus, and he took on that form after killing his younger brother Talos... But a kingdom? Was the entire empire a kingdom?)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I don't know why the ancient beastmen wrote down my name and Ocellino's name, but my brother was trying to get an answer from me.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Because they seemed that desperate... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ocellino… .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Didn't he die a long time ago? Do you even know about that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it... . I'll tell you someday when I get the chance.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Yeah, I get it. I mistook my brothers for intruders, but realized they had no hostility and talked to them.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: They followed God and mourned the fact that they could not save their people in God's name.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: There wasn't much I could do for my brother. I thought God's story would be helpful, so I told them a story from my twilight years that they didn't know about... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Surprisingly, he seemed satisfied. And the brothers made medicine from ingredients they brought from Knossos to help Scylla's illness subside.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: There is hope that Scylla's fever will go down and she will wake up. I was happy and tried to give my brother a gift, but my younger brother Talos refused what he wanted, saying it was okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the weapon you gave me.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: That's right. I don't know why Talos refused... . On a warm, sunny day, they hurried away, saying they were helpful.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I didn't know how it helped... , that was their last sighting.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Fortunately, Scylla woke up a few days later, and after listening to Hayden's explanation, we were able to stay together on the island.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I'm glad I was able to repay Daedalus back then, but I don't know why I need this now... .

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: The Daedalus you know now seems to be very different from before... . Could you tell us about him for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll just tell you everything I know.
(Glaucus is surprised to hear the story about Daedalus, now Talos, from %s.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Give me back the weapon I gave you. I'll give it back to you soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. here… .
(Glaucus holds the weapon he was holding in his other hand together with the weapon he was holding. After a moment, a holy light appears on the weapon and then disappears.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Now, take it. I imbued the island with its energy so that it would not be used for evil purposes. If I end up doing something that goes against God, I'm sure I'll regret it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel relieved.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: … Glad I can help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go back now. Thank you for your time.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: If you need a weapon or something later, come see me. If you clean out the dusty warehouse, you might find something you need.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Haha..., I guess I should come here often...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should we go to Talos... . Nothing much will happen, right?
(It doesn't seem to react at all, but Talos's ears are working harder than usual.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You brought it as promised. Give it to me right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I brought the goods with great difficulty, but the sound of doing so... . You can't even hide it anymore.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daedalus.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What is that? I'm a person who doesn't already exist. Oh wow, this is better than I thought.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glaucus said he was fortunate to be able to return the favor.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Okay. Hyeonshin… . No, he was just an old man who had been living for a long time since we first met.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Hehe, Daedalus deserved to be coveted. The incarnation said it was nothing, but in fact... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Want to hear more? Can I do this with my bare mouth?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why does the story go like that?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Through this incident, you got more information about a popular guy like me. Don't be so angry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if I want to get more angry?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Right now, a village in the Sylvaria Empire... . Damn, it stings!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Are you going to make a village suffer? ah! Repton!
(At some point, an electric lepton flies over and approaches Talos, rubbing its entire body.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ah, take this off!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if you don’t like it?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Take it off!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please take it off, try it.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ah, take it off. Take it off!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lepton, can you rub it with a little more emotion?
(At %s’s words, Lepton’s expression turns into an exclamation mark. At that moment, Talos, sensing something wrong, lowers his head.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Take it off!! Let me tell you something you want!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Talos. Repton, did you hear that? You're going to step down now, and next time you threaten people, you're going to hide here and make Talos suffer?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Haha… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I've been caught by a terrible spirit. Phew, I can't help it. Since you are a helpful spirit to Knossos, I will look after you just this once.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Your mouth is still alive.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You have to live a long life to survive. eww… .
(Lepton flies in front of Talos' face and begins to hover.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Okay, okay. calm down. At least I'll be quiet in front of Repton. Then I'll give you something. Hint, hint.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hint?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Do you remember the voice of Orca's subordinate that remains noisy in El Anor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… . If it's that voice... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Orca made a promise to him. I'll come back someday. But, it didn't come back. Like an ancient god who ran away.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos, what do you mean... .
(As soon as he finishes speaking, Talos climbs the tree and runs at high speed. I try to chase after him, but I don't think I can chase him because he knows the geography of Knossos.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Orca's subordinate? … . Suddenly I can't remember my name... . I'll have to look for it. But what does that existence mean?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I have to go back first. It doesn't look like Talos will say anything more.
(As Adventurer returns to the El Anor mountain path, Talos, who had disappeared, slowly comes down from the tree.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I threw the bait according to the threat, so don't come and bother me. These ‘witches’.
